reviews.text: Sales people are knowledgeable and extremely friendly.my dog really loves them all.

Credit store. Food and treats for dogs with special diets can be found here. The service is always first-class and the selection is great.
Great pet food store, always a nice salesperson

I have always bought cat litter and raw food from here. Good, professional service, free samples available as needed.
Unfortunately, the cat supplies section has shrunk considerably.
Great selection of food, both raw and cooked.

I was looking for food for my cat. The entire store was 95% dog goods and food. Where are the needs of cats?
There are millions of cats in Finland and they are also very demanding when it comes to food and living conditions. Even more demanding than dogs.
However, I found what I wanted, and paid for it, honey.
Sufficient selection of raw food. We also found large deer skins here.
